title: Tenant IAM mapper and Helm plan preflight for safe RBAC bootstrapping
author: Ava Thompson
release_notes: Add tenant-scoped IAM mapping operator; Helm preflight plan checks before apply; Terraform plan validator integration; safer rollbacks for RBAC drift; docs and migration notes included.
description: Summary: Introduces a Tenant IAM Mapper component and a Helm preflight validator to make RBAC bootstrapping in private deployments safer and auditable. Motivation: Private installs frequently require tenant-scoped role bindings and self-service tenant onboarding. Previous bootstrap flows used ad-hoc templates which caused two classes of failures: silent over-privileging during first-bootstrap and drift during upgrades. This PR provides an operator that maps tenant definitions to minimal Role/ClusterRole bindings and a Helm preflight step that runs a dry-run plan (helm template + terraform plan when TF-managed) and surfaces a concise permissions delta so operators can approve or abort. Implementation: 1) tenant-iam-mapper operator (Go): reconciles Tenant CRD -> generates namespaced RoleBindings and optionally creates a limited ClusterRole in controlled namespaces. Mapping rules are policy-driven and live under deploy/roles/policies.yaml. 2) Helm preflight plugin: a small controller-hook that calls helm template for chart revisions, runs a delta check against a stored baseline fingerprint, and integrates with terraform by invoking 'terraform plan -out' when TF modules are present under infra/terraform. 3) Safe-apply controller: when preflight is approved, apply happens via a staged apply that records a manifest fingerprint and writes a reversible plan in state/rollback-manifests/ for quick rollback. 4) Tests & docs: includes unit tests for mapper logic, e2e tests in perf-canary cluster simulating tenant onboarding, and an operator guide in docs/private-installer/rbac-preflight.md. Rollout plan: defaults to disabled. Cluster operators can enable the mapper and preflight via values.yaml: installer.enableTenantIamMapper=true; gradual rollout recommended: alpha on staging, enable telemetry and alerting for denied bindings for one week, then enable in production. Compatibility: The mapper produces conservative bindings only; existing clusters will not be modified unless installer.enableTenantIamMapper is toggled. For TF-managed installs the preflight will only run if terraform root module includes AffectedResources output. Security: the operator validates requested bindings against a policy allow-list; service account used for apply must have a narrow set of privileges described in docs. Migration notes: provide a migration script scripts/migrate-old-rbac.sh to convert legacy templates into policy entries. Related work: builds on ENG-1942 (rbac templates refactor) and ENG-1989 (installer lifecycle improvements).
commits: 4 commits: feat(mapper): add tenant-iam-mapper controller and CRD; feat(preflight): helm preflight plugin + terraform plan bridge; feat(rollbacks): staged-apply and fingerprint recorder; test/docs: e2e for tenant mapping and operator guide

merge_summary: Merged feature/tenant-iam-mapper-helm-preflight into main via squash. All CI green. Migration notes added and docs updated.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: mis-generated ClusterRole could over-privilege tenants. Mitigation: default is conservative namespaced roles; ClusterRole creation is gated behind explicit policy entries and a deny-list automated test; preflight requires operator approval for ClusterRole deltas; staged-apply records reversible manifests for quick rollback.
